svg.title: How does the grid refer to its sessions?
svg.desc: A split contains two tiles; a leaf refers to session metadata by ID. Rearranging tiles changes placement without making the layout own a provider process.
svg.text: How does the grid refer to its sessions?
Grid layout · selected type relationships, not runtime class inheritance
